output.6: 82.1% of employees who achieved their division’s goals conducted a “reflection on their initial commitment” [When you hit a dead end, look back on your initial commitment!] | Corporate Event & Creative Production by Orgiast
output.7: Orgiast Co., Ltd. (Head Office: Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture; Representative Director & President: 金功勇) is pleased to announce the results of a survey on “reflection on initial commitment” conducted among 106 employees who achieved their business division goals for fiscal year 2021 and 104 employees who did not achieve their goals (total of 210 respondents), all of whom have been with their respective companies for 5 to 10 years.
output.10: Q1. In fiscal year 2021, have you ever experienced or felt that you had hit a dead end in your work?
output.11: Q2. In fiscal year 2021, please tell us the situations in which you felt you had hit a dead end at work. (Multiple answers allowed)
output.12: “Q3. In addition to the situations you answered in Q2, please feel free to tell us any other situations in fiscal year 2021 where you felt you had hit a dead end at work. (Free response)”
output.14: <Employees who did not achieve goals: Free responses (excerpts) (n=86)>
output.15: Q4. From the time you joined the company until now, has there been an opportunity to reflect on your initial commitment?
output.16: Q5. Do you think it is important to reflect on your initial commitment when you hit a dead end at work?
output.17: Q6. Did you make a declaration of determination at the company entrance ceremony?
output.18: Q7. Do you think that an “entrance ceremony video,” which records the declaration of determination in your own words, is effective for reflecting on your initial commitment?
output.19: Q8. Do you think the “entrance ceremony video” also contributes to preventing employee turnover?
output.20: Q9. Please tell us the reasons why you think the “entrance ceremony video” contributes to preventing employee turnover. (Multiple answers allowed)
output.21: Q10. In addition to the reasons you answered in Q9, please feel free to tell us any other reasons why you think the entrance ceremony video contributes to preventing employee turnover. (Free response)
output.23: <Employees who did not achieve goals: Free responses (excerpts) (n=22)>
output.26: Survey Overview: Fact-finding survey on “reflection on initial commitment”
output.29: Valid Responses: 106 employees who achieved their business division goals for fiscal year 2021 and 104 employees who did not achieve their goals, all of whom have been with their companies for 5 to 10 years (total of 210 respondents)
output.30: The percentage of employees who felt they had “hit or were hitting a dead end at work” in fiscal year 2021 was 3.5 points higher among those who did not achieve their goals.
output.31: Regarding the situations in which they felt they had hit a dead end, “a heavy workload leading to fatigue” was the most common response, regardless of whether goals were achieved or not.
output.32: ・Age 31: Unfamiliarity with remote work and an increase in work due to COVID-19 countermeasures.
output.33: ・Age 33: Became unsure of what to set as goals.
output.34: ・Age 29: Still unable to visit clients due to the impact of COVID-19, making it difficult to conduct sales activities such as discussions and new proposals, and could not figure out how to get closer to sales targets, feeling stuck.
output.35: ・Age 29: Differences of opinion with a supervisor.
output.36: ・Age 33: More people leaving than being hired; despite a shortage of staff, only the amount of work required continues to increase.
output.37: ・Age 39: Worried about whether further growth is possible.
output.38: ・Age 36: With the increase in remote work during the pandemic, interactions with colleagues decreased, leading to lower motivation and sense of fulfillment.
output.39: ・Age 30: When preparations made, constantly disrupted by the state of the COVID-19 infection, turned out to be wasted.
output.41: ・Age 31: When feeling unsettled just going through daily routines.
output.42: ・Age 31: When a subordinate expressed a desire to quit.
output.43: ・Age 32: When new hires joined all at once, requiring extra work that interfered with my own tasks.
output.44: ・Age 29: Clients are working from home, making it impossible to communicate as before.
output.45: ・Age 33: Because the entire industry is in decline, leading to more reactive work rather than proactive tasks.
output.46: ・Age 32: Sales visits were not going well due to the COVID-19 pandemic, and salary and bonuses decreased.
output.47: ・Age 35: When assigned a new task and a problem occurred.
output.48: It appears that employees sometimes hit dead ends due to situations such as “when goals became unclear” or “when unable to maintain motivation.”
output.49: 82.1% of employees who achieved their goals responded that they “had an opportunity to reflect on their initial commitment from joining until now,” which was 19.6 points higher than those who did not achieve their goals.
output.50: 90.6% of employees who achieved their goals responded that “especially when hitting a dead end at work, one should reflect on their initial commitment,” which was 15.6 points higher compared to those who did not achieve their goals.
output.51: Approximately 60% of both goal-achieving and non-achieving employees responded that they “made a declaration of determination at the entrance ceremony.”
output.52: 44.4% of employees who achieved their goals responded that the “entrance ceremony video is effective for reflecting on initial commitment,” which was 13.6 points higher than those who did not achieve their goals.
output.53: Approximately 70% of both goal-achieving and non-achieving employees responded that an “entrance ceremony video,” which records the declaration of determination in one’s own words, contributes to preventing employee turnover.
output.54: Approximately 70% of employees who achieved their goals expected “improvement in motivation through reflecting on initial commitment via the entrance ceremony video,” which was 22.1 points higher than those who did not achieve their goals.
